extracted.intended_audience: CIA ADP customer/user offices and ADP service organizations (e.g., OER, OSI, OP, OF, FMSAC, OCS, RID, CRS, NPIC) preparing the Semiannual Report on ADP Accomplishments required by OMB Circular A-79
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare the Agency submission to OMB Circular A-79 summarizing new/revised computer applications, ADP operations management accomplishments, and plans for the next fiscal year; include benefit estimates (personnel, equipment, dollars), program identification, contractor involvement, and anticipated improvements. Intended for CIA offices to report accomplishments for a specified reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Describe benefits of new or revised computer-based systems (Section I)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inputs should describe new and revised ADP applications (Section I) ... Describe and explain the benefits of each NEW OR REVISED computer-based system implemented during this report period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information in SECTION I normally should be furnished by ADP customer/user offices such as OER, OSI, OP, OF, FMSAC, etc. Focus on benefits realized during the report period (second half FY71).

rubrics_metrics.name: System Description
rubrics_metrics.description: Briefly identify and explain the intelligence (or other) functions and objectives which the computerized system supports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include identification of the Agency Program supported (i.e., category, subcategory, element, etc.), identify and explain any contractor involvement, and indicate any community interest or use of the system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimate personnel savings (manual alternative)
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish your estimate and briefly explain the number of additional people (or man years) that would be required for the Agency to accomplish the objectives of this computer-based system if we were to perform the necessary functions manually (i.e., without a computer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a clear estimate of man-years/personnel that the computerized system replaces or saves; explain assumptions behind the estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative means and cost comparison
rubrics_metrics.description: If you consider an alternative means (e.g., contractor) feasible to accomplish the objectives of this system briefly explain this alternative and furnish your estimate of relative cost advantages or disadvantages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discuss feasible non-Agency alternatives (contractor, manual, other technologies) and provide comparative cost estimates/advantages or disadvantages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other benefits (efficiency, timeliness, accuracy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Briefly explain other benefits of this computerized system such as increases in efficiency, timeliness, accuracy, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantify benefits where possible (e.g., percent improvements, time saved, error reductions); include qualitative benefits if quantification is not feasible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Describe ADP management accomplishments (Section II)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe and explain the benefits of significant ADP operations management accomplishments such as those indicated below. Please furnish your estimate of the ADP equipment, manpower or dollar savings which should result.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SECTION II normally should be furnished by ADP service organizations such as OCS, RID, CRS, and NPIC (PSG/AID). Focus on measurable savings and benefits from management actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standardization or integration of computer systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Report accomplishments in standardization or integration of computer systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain what was standardized/integrated and furnish estimates of resulting equipment, manpower, or dollar savings or operational benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improvements in ADP methods or technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Report improvements in ADP methods or technology achieved during the period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the methodological or technological changes and estimate their impact (efficiency, cost, capability).

rubrics_metrics.name: Negotiation of ADP contracts under more favorable terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Report negotiation of ADP contracts under more favorable terms than provided in the Federal Supply Schedule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide specifics of contract term improvements and estimated cost savings or other benefits compared to standard schedule terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress in handling ADP security problems
rubrics_metrics.description: Report progress in handling ADP security problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe security improvements, mitigations, or resolved issues and estimate impacts on risk, cost, or operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress on research and development of advanced ADP systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Report progress on research and development of advanced ADP systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize R&D achievements, expected capabilities, and anticipated benefits or savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summarize plans expected to result in ADP accomplishments (Section III)
rubrics_metrics.description: Summarize actions planned or underway which are expected to result in ADP accomplishments of the sort indicated in SECTIONS I and II, above. Include a statement of anticipated benefits for each such action planned or underway.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide concise descriptions of planned actions, timelines, anticipated benefits (personnel, equipment, dollar savings), and link plans to the types of accomplishments reported in Sections I and II.

rubrics_metrics.name: User/Customer Plans (Section III.A)
rubrics_metrics.description: User/Customer Plans which deal with the application of computers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe planned application-level efforts by user/customer offices (new systems, revisions, deployments) and state anticipated benefits for each.

rubrics_metrics.name: Computer Center Management Plans (Section III.B)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computer Center Management Plans for improving computer system operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe planned data center/operations management actions (capacity, procedures, staffing, contracts) and expected operational/cost benefits.
